title: WhatsApp
subtitle: Link a WhatsApp number by QR code to send student verification codes over WhatsApp.
connectionHint: One WhatsApp number linked like WhatsApp Web. Codes fall back to SMS when it is unavailable.
disconnectConfirmBody: The number is unlinked from EDUWAY (it disappears from Linked devices on the phone). Verification codes go by SMS until a number is linked again.
connectedHint: Linked {{date}}. Verification codes are sent from this number.
connectingHint: Connecting to WhatsApp… this usually takes a few seconds.
disconnectedHint: No number is linked. Click “Link WhatsApp” and scan the QR code with the phone that owns the number.
otherInstance: The session runs on another server instance; status updates every few seconds.
scanTitle: Scan with the phone that owns the number
scanStep2: Tap Settings (iPhone) or ⋮ Menu (Android) → Linked devices.
scanStep3: Tap “Link a device” and unlock the phone if asked.
scanStep4: Point the phone at this QR code.
qrAutoRefresh: The code refreshes automatically. If it stops, click “Cancel linking” then “Link WhatsApp” again.
notConfigured: WhatsApp linking is not configured on the server: set WHATSAPP_PROVIDER=baileys and WHATSAPP_SESSION_SECRET in the server environment and restart the API.
notSelected: A number can be linked, but verification codes are not sent through it because WHATSAPP_PROVIDER is “{{provider}}”. Set WHATSAPP_PROVIDER=baileys on the server.

errors.logged_out: The device was logged out from the phone. Link the number again.
errors.logged_out_by_admin: The number was unlinked by an admin.
errors.stopped_by_admin: The session was stopped by an admin.
errors.qr_expired: The QR code expired before it was scanned. Click “Link WhatsApp” to get a new one.
errors.replaced_by_another_client: WhatsApp Web was opened for this number elsewhere, which closed this session. Link the number again.
errors.forbidden: WhatsApp refused the connection (the number may be restricted or banned).
errors.multidevice_mismatch: This WhatsApp version does not support linked devices. Update WhatsApp on the phone and link again.
errors.bad_session: The stored session was corrupted and has been cleared. Link the number again.
errors.other: Last connection problem: {{code}}. EDUWAY keeps reconnecting automatically.

testHint: Checks that messages from the linked number are delivered.
testTextHint: Leave empty to send a short bilingual test message.
testTextPlaceholder: EDUWAY: test message — WhatsApp is connected and working.
previewHint: What students receive. The student’s language comes first; codes are valid for {{minutes}} min (Settings → OTP).
previewFallback: If WhatsApp is disconnected or the student’s number is not on WhatsApp, the code is sent by SMS ({{provider}}) and the student is told which channel was used.
warning1: This uses an unofficial WhatsApp Web client. It is against WhatsApp’s Terms of Service and the number can be banned without notice.
warning2: Use a dedicated number for EDUWAY — never a personal or main business number — and keep the phone online.
warning3: For large volumes, move to the official WhatsApp Cloud API (WHATSAPP_PROVIDER=whatsapp_cloud).
